lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Performance task: plan: the fraction number-line gallery

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows how to plan before computing anything.

items.prompt: A shape is divided into 6 equal parts. 5 are shaded. What fraction is shaded?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Decide what the quantities are before you compute anything.

items.prompt: A number line from 0 to 1 is divided into 6 equal lengths. What fraction names the point that is 4 lengths from 0?
A shape is divided into 4 equal parts. 3 of the parts are shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Plan in writing: what you will figure out, how, and how you will check it.

items.prompt: A number line from 0 to 1 is divided into 8 equal lengths. What fraction names the point that is 6 lengths from 0?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A shape is divided into 8 equal parts. 1 of the parts are shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
